patterns.note: Full-width sections with distinct, often vibrant, background colors and textures, creating clear visual breaks and thematic shifts.
Asymmetrical hero composition featuring oversized typography centrally, surrounded by scattered abstract 3D geometric shapes.
High-contrast color palette dominated by a vibrant electric blue, complemented by bright green, pink, and orange accents for graphic elements.
Subtle parallax effect on abstract 3D shapes in the hero section, creating a sense of depth and dynamism as the user scrolls.
Scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, where elements like cards and text blocks fade in or slide up as they enter the viewport.
Prominent statistics sections using large, bold, monospaced numbers to highlight key metrics and achievements.

technique_notes: The site employs a vibrant, high-contrast color scheme with a dominant electric blue background, accented by bright green, pink, and orange geometric shapes to create visual energy.
Typography features oversized, heavy sans-serif headings for maximum impact, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text, and a distinct monospaced font for numerical data.

Abstract 3D geometric shapes are strategically placed throughout the design, particularly in the hero and section dividers, and are animated with a subtle parallax effect using GSAP as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with clean, lighter sans-serif body text and occasional uppercase labels; monospaced for statistics.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (small corner radius on buttons, cards, and input fields)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; hero section is very airy, content sections have balanced padding, card grids are dense within their containers.

standout: The site's standout feature is its vibrant, almost playful use of abstract 3D geometric shapes and bold, high-contrast colors, particularly the electric blue and bright green. This creates a dynamic and energetic feel that differentiates it from more corporate or minimalist crypto sites, while still maintaining a clean and modern aesthetic. The subtle parallax of these shapes adds a layer of sophistication.
